main_body: wooden weaving loom frame with vertical threads and lower legs
top_band: medium brown horizontal top beam (rows 10-11) with a lighter orange-brown front edge line at row 12
evidence: The upper beam has a 2-row top surface (rows 10-11), a 1-row lighter front edge highlight (row 12), and a 1-row darker shadow (row 13) overlapping the recessed vertical warp threads (rows 14-21). The lower beam similarly shows a top surface (row 22), front edge highlight (row 23), and front face (row 24) above the legs (rows 26-31).

style.evidence: While the dark brown outline matches the wood tone, the wood beams and legs are completely uniform horizontal/vertical bands of flat color with zero wood grain or speckling. The warp threads and woven pattern are rigid, repetitive geometric bars lacking the organic shading and rich pixel density of the Beodeul references.
